description: This Java interface defines a Permissions set for managing permissions, including methods for creating instances, checking containment, and JSON serialization support.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: An interface extending Set<String> and Jsonifiable<JsonArray> for managing permissions with JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable Permissions instance with specified permissions.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Creates a new Permissions instance with no permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions; default is JsonSchemaVersion.V_2.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains specified permission(s).

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains all permissions in another Permissions instance.
